findings.body: The test scans `src/forge` and only `docs/guide.md`, so plugin mentions in other new Forge documentation are never checked. For example, `docs/archive.md` is retained documentation (see its lines 28–33) but is excluded. The pattern also misses `codex@openai-codex`, allowing a plugin installation command in a template or outside the guide's uninstall section to pass. Extend the scan to the new Forge documentation, preserving the old-Forge exclusions, and detect the plugin identifier as well as its prose names.
findings.title: Not done: test plugin absence across the new Forge docs and package

findings.body: The revised prerequisites say Codex alone is sufficient, but a Codex coordinator's mandatory cold read invokes Claude Code. `src/forge/story.py:71` maps `CODEX_THREAD_ID` to the Claude reader, and line 144 runs `claude -p`. Someone following this installation guidance without Claude Code cannot complete the story workflow. Explain the opposite-family reader requirement alongside the coordinator and worker choices.
findings.title: Document Claude Code as required for Codex-coordinated cold reads
